name: 10305 · Staten Island, NY
findings: ZIP 10305 (Staten Island) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10305 (Staten Island) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 10305 (Staten Island) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
